controlled_vocabulary.public_coupon: Whether an official reusable public coupon was verified for the reviewed market and date.
controlled_vocabulary.coupon_offer: A specific official coupon value or code-based offer.
controlled_vocabulary.first_order_discount: Discount specifically limited to a first purchase.
controlled_vocabulary.signup_discount: Discount issued after email, newsletter, subscriber, or community signup.
controlled_vocabulary.student_discount: Discount specifically available to verified students.
controlled_vocabulary.eligible_group_discount: Discount available after verification for one or more eligible groups.
controlled_vocabulary.referral_discount: Discount tied to an official referral program.
controlled_vocabulary.member_discount: Discount or reward available through an official membership program.
controlled_vocabulary.subscription_discount: Discount tied to recurring product subscription.
controlled_vocabulary.bundle_discount: Discount tiers or amounts tied to a qualifying bundle.
controlled_vocabulary.promotion_discount: A concrete discount amount stated for a time-limited official promotion.
controlled_vocabulary.promotion_schedule: Recurring schedule for an official promotion.
controlled_vocabulary.promotion_period: Explicit start and end dates for an official promotion.
controlled_vocabulary.coupon_validity_period: Time period during which an issued coupon remains valid.
controlled_vocabulary.coupon_usage_limit: Single-use, account-bound, or other coupon usage limitation.
controlled_vocabulary.coupon_issuance_frequency: How often an eligible shopper may obtain a coupon.
controlled_vocabulary.coupon_stacking_rule: Whether the coupon or promotion can be combined with another discount.
controlled_vocabulary.discount_threshold: Minimum qualifying purchase amount for a discount.
controlled_vocabulary.discount_scope: Products, categories, or circumstances included in or excluded from a discount.
controlled_vocabulary.discount_eligibility: Who qualifies for a discount or how eligibility is established.
controlled_vocabulary.free_shipping_threshold: Minimum order amount required for free shipping.
controlled_vocabulary.free_shipping_scope: Orders, products, customers, or destinations covered by free shipping.
controlled_vocabulary.free_shipping_method: Delivery method specifically covered by free shipping.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_fee_below_threshold: Shipping charge below a stated free-shipping threshold.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_processing_time: Time from order receipt to shipment or fulfillment.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_transit_time: Delivery transit time after shipment or fulfillment.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_destination_scope: Destinations served by the shipping policy.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_method: Carrier or delivery method used for shipment.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_restriction: Explicit destination, address, fee, or product shipping restriction.
controlled_vocabulary.shipping_address_change_rule: Whether and when a delivery address may be changed.
controlled_vocabulary.return_window: Time allowed to initiate a standard return.
controlled_vocabulary.defect_claim_window: Time allowed to make a defect or quality claim.
controlled_vocabulary.exchange_window: Time allowed to request a non-quality exchange.
controlled_vocabulary.return_condition: Required condition, packaging, accessories, or use state for a return.
controlled_vocabulary.return_authorization_requirement: Whether approval or an RMA is required before return shipment.
controlled_vocabulary.return_shipping_responsibility: Who pays return shipping under stated circumstances.
controlled_vocabulary.return_method: Required return label or shipment process.
controlled_vocabulary.return_label_delivery_time: Time stated for delivery of a required return label.
controlled_vocabulary.restocking_fee: Restocking fee stated for a return or exchange.
controlled_vocabulary.refund_processing_time: Time stated to issue a refund after receipt or approval.
controlled_vocabulary.cancellation_window: Time allowed to cancel an order before shipment.
controlled_vocabulary.delivery_issue_reporting_window: Time allowed to report damage, defects, or an incorrect delivery.
controlled_vocabulary.defect_return_remedy: Return or replacement remedy for a confirmed defective product.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_term: Length of standard or product-scoped warranty coverage.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_scope: Products, components, defects, or exclusions covered by a warranty.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_registration_requirement: Registration requirement or deadline for warranty coverage.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_start_basis: Event or date from which warranty coverage begins.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_extension: Additional warranty coverage available after a qualifying action.
controlled_vocabulary.refurbished_warranty_term: Warranty length specifically stated for refurbished products.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_remedy: Repair, replacement, parts, or shipping remedy for a covered warranty claim.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_shipping_responsibility: Who pays shipping associated with warranty service.
controlled_vocabulary.warranty_replacement_term: Warranty treatment of a replacement product.
controlled_vocabulary.optional_protection_plan: Optional paid protection-plan terms or durations.
controlled_vocabulary.replacement_processing_time: Time stated to ship an approved replacement.
